sokkel-tui.note: Not in sokkel-tui's reports as of b99664f.

summary: Several short values typed into one field, each a chip: Enter or a comma adds one, Backspace in an empty input takes the last off, and suggestions are offered as the viewer types.

anatomy.container: A field (parts' Field: label, hint, description, help, issue mark) around the frame.
anatomy.frame: At least the control's height, wrapping, 4 apart, padded 6 across and 4 down, on field, edged in input, rounded by radius-control: the chips, then the input taking the rest of the line, never narrower than 96. Focused, edged and ringed 1 in ring; with an issue, edged in critical at 80 percent.
anatomy.chip: Each tag as parts/chip with its remove button, named by remove.
anatomy.input: 24 tall, padded 4 across, at text.sm, no frame of its own; the placeholder only while there are no tags.
anatomy.suggestions: While the text matches suggestions not in already: a list under the frame, 4 below it, of up to six, padded 4, on popover, edged in border, rounded by radius-control, with a pop shadow; each padded 8 across and 4 down, the marked one on hover.

onValueChange.does: Called with the tags after each one added or removed.

suggestions.does: Tags offered as the viewer types.

normalize.does: Turns what is typed into a tag; trimmed by default.

disabled.does: Turns it off: no input and no remove buttons.

focus.means: The input focused: the frame edged and ringed in ring.

refused.means: A tag in already or past max: not added, the issue said.
refused.reached: adding a duplicate, or a tag when full

keyboard.does: Adds what is typed, or the marked suggestion.
Marks the next or the previous suggestion.
Clears what is typed, closing the suggestions.

drift.today: As of b99664f its reports name no such part.
